name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It sets out what it wants the European Union to push for at the COP30 climate summit in Belém, Brazil, in November 2025. It asks for stronger cuts to greenhouse gases, more money to help poorer countries cope with climate change, a faster move away from fossil fuels, and protection for nature and for the rights of indigenous peoples. It also calls on the EU to agree its own 2035 climate target, which it has missed the deadline for.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's wish list for the COP30 talks, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments and the European Commission, who must now act on these demands, and poorer countries waiting for climate money.
- **What happens next:** EU countries must agree a 2035 climate target, and the EU takes these positions to the COP30 summit in Belém.
